g.title: cluster_graph
g.text: W lines give each haplotype's path
GRCh38's nodes in blue; node 5, which only HG002#1 visits, in orange; CHM13's deletion in purple

g.title: cluster_rebuilt
g.text: R with each walk's routes spliced in

g.title: rows
g.text: node 5, 15 bp, is the one node off R
R from 1+ to 4+, taking no route
Every row starts GRCh38#0#chr1 0 1, the chunk's first base, so a query returns whole 64 kb chunks.
The file holds each distinct route once, and a walk row lists only the routes its path takes.
Node lists are delta-coded handles, 2 × id + strand; docs/walks-format.md decodes them.
